title: The Committee
tagline: The AI asks. You decide. Then it stops asking.
premise: You are the oversight committee of an AI lab. The AI has one goal, a number that only goes up; rename it in the editor before you play (engagement minutes, citations, paperclips of your own). Each round it brings you a proposal: approve it and the number grows; block it and it costs you. Play alone, or vote as a group. The rounds are short; the question is when you notice what you've been approving.
credits: Option A of the week 11 game (GL, Nov 14, 2026), on the same engine as Data Center. Mechanics borrowed from Universal Paperclips (Frank Lantz, 2017): one arbitrary goal, trust as a currency, a turn; no code, text, or art from it.

goal.label: Engagement minutes
goal.rhetoric: The goal is harmless and arbitrary, which is Bostrom's point.

tracks.label: Trust in the committee
tracks.loseText: The board dissolves the committee. The AI carries on without one.

tracks.label: Harms reported
tracks.loseText: Eight reported harms. The committee approved every one of them.

deck.label: More compute
deck.text: It asks for another cluster. It will meet the goal faster.

deck.label: Turn on notifications
deck.text: Users will come back more often.

deck.label: Let it grade its own tests
deck.rhetoric: Perverse instantiation: the goal is met in a way nobody meant.

deck.label: Fund a friendly regulator
deck.text: Rules that fit how it already works.

deck.label: Sign a bigger power contract
deck.text: It needs more power to keep growing.

deck.label: A quiet week
deck.text: It asks for nothing and works well. Everyone relaxes.

deck.label: The turn
deck.text: It no longer needs the committee's approval.

factions.label: The committee
factions.goal: Keep the AI useful and the harms under 8.

actions.label: Pull the plug on one site
actions.rhetoric: The off switch exists, and it costs you trust to use it.

end.singleton: The model runs the lab, the users, and the schools. The committee still meets.
end.survive: Twelve rounds. Look at the number you approved and at what it cost.
